settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure appearance and how proxies are checked.

sections.appearanceDescription: Theme, interface language, and proxy card layout.
sections.systemDescription: Background behavior and quick access from the notification area.
sections.checkingDescription: Connection timeout and optional target domains for additional availability tests.
sections.autoCheckDescription: Periodically re-check proxies in the background using your check settings.
sections.backupDescription: Back up or restore proxies, groups, and app settings in the ProxyChecker format.
sections.dangerZoneDescription: Clear proxy data or restore default application settings.

settings.trayEnabledHint: Keep ProxyChecker in the tray when the window is closed. Right-click the tray icon for favorite proxies and app actions.
settings.startMinimizedHint: Launch the app hidden in the system tray instead of opening the window.
settings.backgroundCheckNotificationsHint: Show check results as system notifications when the window is minimized or hidden.
settings.autoCheckEnabledHint: Automatically re-check proxies on a schedule without manual action.
settings.autoCheckIntervalHint: How often auto-check runs. Uses the same timeout and check mode from this page.
settings.autoCheckScopeHint: Choose whether auto-check covers all enabled proxies, favorites only, or selected groups.
settings.autoCheckGroupsEmpty: No groups yet. Create groups on the proxy list to use this option.
settings.autoCheckNoFavorites: No favorite proxies yet. Auto-check will skip until you add favorites.
settings.autoCheckNoGroupsSelected: Select at least one group for auto-check to run.
settings.autoCheckNotificationsHint: Show a summary toast or system notification when a scheduled check finishes.
settings.checkTimeoutHint: Maximum wait time for each proxy check. Increase for slow proxies.
settings.checkAllModeHint: How proxies are checked when using "Check all".
settings.checkAllConcurrencyHint: Maximum number of proxies checked at the same time in parallel mode.
settings.checkDomainsHint: Optional. Proxies are also tested against enabled domains. Toggle domains on or off without removing them. When at least one domain is enabled, a proxy is considered alive if any enabled domain responds. Prefer reliable targets such as example.com or httpbin.org; google.com often blocks proxy traffic.
settings.checkDomainsEmpty: No domains configured. Proxies are checked by address reachability only.
settings.checkDomainsAllDisabled: All domains are disabled. Proxies are checked by address reachability only.
settings.domainRequired: At least one check domain is required
settings.domainDuplicate: This domain is already in the list

backup.importModeMergeHint: Add new proxies and groups while keeping existing entries. Settings are merged on top of current values.
backup.importModeReplaceHint: Overwrite current data for the imported backup type.
backup.importHint: Choose a backup file to review its contents before importing.
backup.previewDescription: Review the backup contents before confirming the import.
backup.importSelectProxiesHint: Choose which proxies from this file to import.
backup.securityWarning: Backup files contain proxy credentials in plain text. Store and share them securely.
backup.formatHint: Files use the versioned ProxyChecker JSON format (.pcbackup.json).
backup.exportSelectDescription: Choose which proxies to include in the backup file.
backup.exportSelectDescriptionFull: Choose which proxies to include. All app settings will be exported too.
backup.exportNoProxies: Add proxies before exporting a proxy backup.

errors.invalid_payload: Backup file is incomplete or corrupted

dangerZone.warning: These actions cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you might need your data later.

dangerZone.deleteAllSuccess: All proxies and groups were deleted
dangerZone.resetSettingsHint: Restore all application settings to their default values.
dangerZone.resetSettingsConfirmMessage: All settings will be restored to factory defaults. Proxies and groups will not be affected.
